limitations: Source candidate is not a geometry integrated in POLY viewer.
Term counts are not individual muscle counts.
Left/right Z-Anatomy pairs share original mesh and differ by source transform, not by donor.
Three cranial landmarks are insufficient to spatially register torso and pelvis.
Muscle-to-nerve and tendon-to-bone connections require independent evidence and spatial mapping.
